verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own docs list "flows" among the analyses users can query, and a community user praises the Flow feature for showing user flows quickly and clearly. Another user reports a hover-heavy UI that is hard to dig into. No first-party doc in the pack describes a Flows report or how to anchor it on a key event to see paths before or after it. missing for 10: first-party Flows report documentation, explicit before/after-event path exploration, recent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can explore the paths users actually take before or after a key event

citations.quote: you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language
This really gets to the heart of most of the information you need on user flows and its fast and clear.
